query_normalized: predicting plant disease severity from publicly available image data and meteorological records biology
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (b) and (e) because it provides a canonical dataset containing the exact independent variables (publicly available high-resolution plant images and meteorological records) and the dependent variable domain (plant phenotypes) required for the user's research on predicting plant disease severity, even though the paper itself focuses on describing the dataset rather than the specific prediction model.
